course_name_original: Aktive und passive Sicherheit von Fahrzeuge
course_name_en: Active and Passive Safety of Vehicles

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the fundamentals of vehicle safety.
They understand the methods of active and passive safety, the technical relationships, the development goals and functionalities of protection systems in vehicles.
The relationships of integral vehicle safety and their effectiveness can be demonstrated.
Measures to increase road safety can be described and compared in terms of their effectiveness.
Based on basic mechanical knowledge, students can calculate the behavior of vehicles in braking and crash situations and identify potential improvements.
The behavior of occupant and opponent protection systems can be calculated in a simplified manner.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of vehicle safety and accident research
Biomechanics and injury mechanisms, crash load cases and protection criteria
Requirements and potential of passive vehicle safety
Requirements and potential of active safety
Visibility concepts, lighting systems, air conditioning, vehicle glazing and operating concepts with regard to perception safety, condition safety and operating safety
assessment_rules: The type of examination (written or oral) will be determined at the beginning of the semester. To earn credit points, the module examination must be passed. The grade's importance for the final grade is weighted by credit points.
bibliography: Kramer, F., Integrale Sicherheit von Kraftfahrzeugen, Springer, ISBN 978-3-8348-2607-7
